meta.name: strategic-alliances
meta.description: Structures partnerships that change what the business can do — technology integrations, channel and reseller arrangements, joint ventures, and OEM relationships. Use this to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, decide between partnering and building, negotiate commercial terms of an alliance, or diagnose a partnership that is signed but not producing. For audience-borrowing partnerships, use `marketing:partnership-marketing`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估、构建并落地能让企业能力升级的战略合作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正考虑用技术、渠道或合资伙伴扩展业务,却不确定如何评估和谈判。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and land strategic partnerships that expand what your business can do

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你评估战略联盟:判断某项能力该找伙伴、自建还是收购,核对双方谁更在乎,逐条确认关键条款,并诊断签约后不产出的合作哪里卡住。
howto.when: 当你说要处理某个战略伙伴关系的结构与条款、决定自建还是找伙伴,或诊断签了约却不出成果的合作时,它会触发。借受众的营销合作不归它管。

say.text: 帮我判断:和这家渠道商合作还是自建渠道?
say.note: 他会用“伙伴变成对手怎么办”等问题引导决策。

say.text: 我们签的联盟半年没产出,帮我诊断卡在哪。
say.note: 他会查负责人、激励错位和未交付的技术依赖。

say.text: 我要谈技术整合协议,条款该怎么逐条定?
say.note: 他会带你对齐排他性、收入、客户归属、退出等条款。

howto.what_en: Claude uses a strategic-alliance framework to guide you: choose whether to partner, build, or buy; check what each side actually wants; confirm key contract terms; and diagnose why a signed but non-producing alliance is stuck.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to structure or negotiate an alliance, decide between building and partnering, or diagnose a signed partnership that isn't producing. Audience-borrowing marketing partnerships are out of scope.

say_en.text: Help me decide whether to partner with this channel or build our own.
say_en.note: He walks through 'what if they become a competitor?'

say_en.text: Our alliance signed six months ago isn't producing—diagnose why.
say_en.note: Checks named owner, incentives, missing dependencies.

say_en.text: I'm negotiating a tech integration agreement—which terms should I pin down?
say_en.note: Covers exclusivity, economics, customer ownership, exit.
